title: Trading S/R — DBS/SSR Strategies

edits.reason: The lesson teaches the full S/R-flip long triad — 'Entry timing: for long after SSR flip, set limit bids at the TOP of the now-flipped zone; STOP below zone; TARGET at next SSR level above.' The def draws the flip level (100, zone bottom) and the zone area (98-104) but draws NONE of entry/stop/target as levels (they exist only as the 'S/R Flip Entry!' and 'Target Ahead' callout pins). Entry at 104 = the explicitly named 'top of the now-flipped zone' (top edge of the 98-104 zone), teal=long. Stop at 96 sits just below the 98 zone floor (inside band 82-118), pink against the long. Target at 117 sits at the final leg's run to 118, gold magnet for the take-profit. All three yAxis are inside the visible band; together they complete the entry/stop/target the prose names but the chart never levels.

notes: introChart: REJECTED the auditor's proposed markLine {yAxis:86,'Upper DBS Limit'}. It is redundant — 86 is already the top EDGE of the DBS Zone markArea (81-86), AND the orderBook bid wall is heaviest at 86 labelled 'Bid Wall — Aggressive DBS Entry', AND markPoint idx 8 says 'Bids at Upper DBS'. The aggressive-entry price is thus drawn three ways already; a line at 86 would overlap the area's top edge and add no teaching value on a concept/intro chart where restraint applies. The stop (yAxis 79) is correct: zone is 81-86, 'stop below zone' -> 79 is below 81 and inside band 81-111. quiz.chart: ALREADY GOOD as the auditor found — cutIndex:11 hides the outcome, pre-cut only draws context (SSR flip level 100 + flipped zone 98-103, no spoiler), and the outcome (breakout idx9 / first retest idx11 / flip entry idx12 / running idx14) is correctly routed to revealMarkPoints. All proposed dataIndexes verified in range (lessonChart 18 bars, quiz 15 bars) and authored without manual offset to match existing markPoints. ADDED beyond the auditor: the lessonChart Entry-at-top-of-zone level (104) — the auditor proposed only stop+target and missed that the named entry ('top of the now-flipped zone') is also undrawn-as-a-level, leaving the trade triad incomplete.
